title: Cheddar Jalapeño Meatballs

items: 50-70 grams canned jalapenos, i used both green and red

method: Place the jalapenos in a paper towel to dry the jalapenos from the jar water so you dont make the mince too wet
Add all the ingredients to a bowl and keep aside till use
In a pan, scoop the meatballs in a pan and cook till done
I serve my meatballs with a ladle of tomato passta
tips: Round shape: You can add 2-3 tbsp corn flour or bread crumbs if you want to achieve perfect round meatballs, I don’t to keep the carbs low
Cheese: any sharp cheese will work well here like gouda, parmesan, etc | also, you can use more cheese if you prefer :)
Stuffing: you can also stuff the meatballs with a small cube of cheese, its yumm but increases the calorie count though makes for a great starter :)
Oil: i haven’t used any to fry the meatballs as im using a non stick pan and choose not to since the chicken mince gives out some fat that lets you cook the meatballs in and gives good flavour
I hope you enjoy this recipe and try it soon
caption:
Cheddar Jalapeño Meatballs
meal prep | high protein

Nutrition: 
C: 11 | F: 16 | P: 51
Calories: 343 per serving
serves 2 or 3 depending on your appetite
(calories mentioned are considering 2 serves, you can increase to 3 serves which comes to around 229 per serve) 

Ingredients
450 grams chicken mince
50-70 grams canned jalapenos, i used both green and red
30 grams cheddar cheese, grated
1 egg
1 tsp pepper
salt, to taste
1 tsp red chilli flakes
1 tsp oregano 

Method
place the jalapenos in a paper towel to dry the jalapenos from the jar water so you dont make the mince too wet
add all the ingredients to a bowl and keep aside till use 
in a pan, scoop the meatballs in a pan and cook till done
I serve my meatballs with a ladle of tomato passta

pro tip: 
round shape: You can add 2-3 tbsp corn flour or bread crumbs if you want to achieve perfect round meatballs, I don’t to keep the carbs low
cheese: any sharp cheese will work well here like gouda, parmesan, etc | also, you can use more cheese if you prefer :) 
stuffing: you can also stuff the meatballs with a small cube of cheese, its yumm but increases the calorie count though makes for a great starter :) 
oil: i haven’t used any to fry the meatballs as im using a non stick pan and choose not to since the chicken mince gives out some fat that lets you cook the meatballs in and gives good flavour 

i hope you enjoy this recipe and try it soon
